name: Microgrid reference-established confirmation
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Confirms the defined voltage, frequency and source states before later restoration steps.
description: Confirms the defined voltage, frequency and source states before later restoration steps. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Island measurements and source feedback” at the input and “Reference-ready status” at the output. Stability criteria require a validated scheme.
